spans.text: "Maze Cage No. 3", participant T-Dolls—PA-15, QBU-88, Falcon, Stechkin, wz.29.
Data loading...
Test Objective... Test Content...
Test Principles... List Variables...
Loading command procedure...
...Wait.
Persica interrupts her assistant, who was taking notes.
For this group, we're going to add a new variable.
New variables? Where can we possibly add new variables now?
Don't you worry. They'll be here any minute now.
At the Griffin base.
Listen up! Starting today, this will be your new workspace.
This is where you will spend your entire internship.
Your classmates will become comrades that you fight side by side with in the future. Provided, of course, that you are all able to pass the examination.
Yes ma'am!
...And one more thing.
Some of you may find strange cards in your dorms.
A friendly reminder of mine would be to just throw them away when you see them. Definitely do not partake in the dubious paid experiments listed on them.
Whispers and mumblings can be heard among the crowd of interns...
Everything is a novelty to this group of newcomers; evidently, the less they are allowed to do something, the more they can't help but... get involved.
May I ask, is it against the rules to do so?
It's not explicitly forbidden, but it would be preferable that you do not heed those cards.
It's for your own sake— That's it for today, dismissed!
After Helian left, the bubbling crowd disperses and heads to their own dormitories to unpack their belongings.
As you walk through the door, you notice that you've stepped on a card.
What is this...?
I.O.P headquarters building, 16th floor, Lab No. 9.
Although the weather outside is as clear as it gets, the floor inside is shrouded in darkness by the tinted glass; not a single beam of light can be seen.
The nameplate on the doorway reads Persicaria, there's no mistaking it.
Knock knock!
—Who!
The frantic voice inside the room startles you. With the card in hand, you double-check that the address is correct before mustering the courage to answer.
Hello, you were recruiting test subjects here, right?
...You're here to apply?
—Coming!
The sound of items falling to the floor can be heard from inside the room, lasting for the next 2 minutes.
...W-Wait a minute! Don't leave—
I'm impressed that someone actually got roped in by your little cards.
"Roped in" is quite the harsh way to put it.
This is legitimate recruiting.
So, your name, please?
I am...

choices: Cadet 41 of the 2060 class of the Department of Tactical Command.
You said on the card that anonymity is allowed since we'd have to sneak out.

spans.text: The name isn't important. Just write "Intern".
This is the Subjects' General Manual for this lab. Please familiarize yourself with it.
...Uh, okay.
What do I need to do next then?
It's simple. We need you to cooperate with us in commanding a small team of Dolls for our experiment.
And the specifics are...
Please follow the command guidelines that have been uploaded. First do this... then this, and finally this. All you need is to reach the target location by the end. Got it?
RO635's finger jumped around on the command tablet at dazzling speeds. It was hard to follow any of her instructions.
Any further questions?

Excuse me, Miss Assistant, there's something I want to ask. Looking at the raw data, the strength disparity between the enemy and us is overwhelming, and there's nothing particularly special about the tactics. If I follow through with this plan...
Pardon my bluntness, but this is just sending Dolls to their deaths.
As a subject, you don't need to worry about these. Just follow the guidelines to the letter.
If there are no further questions, let's get started—
